body_loading: max(smoothed Re(Y),0) times T/L; clipped 0..10 /s. Passive diagonal damping approximation, not a full admittance feedback model.

clips.description: Same Bach performance timing and fingering in both synths. Compare the string material or guitar body named on each button, then check against Kowalski’s recording. Material choices change harmonic stiffness and decay; measured bodies change resonance and string damping. Wound basses are the same in both material sets. This first version approximates bridge loading; full string/body interaction is still to come. Measured responses include some room sound and come from different guitars than Kowalski’s.
clips.question: Which synth is closer to the real performance?
